title: WGP-ABF Standard Part Descriptor v0.6
description: A machine-readable descriptor for a standard ABIR part. partKind preserves the six ABIR object categories. I0-I4 records controlled interchangeability and is independent from F3-F0 structural provenance.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

partKind.description: Direct lowercase mapping to the six ABIR object categories.

permissionPolicy.description: An immutable executable allow/deny policy used by the minimal conformance example.

requirementMappings.description: Executable mappings from Descriptor permission-requirement tuples to policy rules. A mapping covers only its exact permissionId, scope, action, and resource.

artifactRecord.description: Resolution record for exactArtifactRef. contentHash covers the referenced artifact bytes, not this metadata record.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the exact artifact bytes.

localPath.description: Portable relative path. Resolvers must reject absolute paths and any path that escapes their configured artifact root.

exactRuntimeEventRef.description: An immutable RuntimeEvent identity plus the SHA-256 of its RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes.

registryRecord.description: One immutable record in an append-only registry log. Revocation and tombstone are new records; they never rewrite an earlier publication.

recordHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root recordHash member omitted.

bindings.description: Exact channel-role pairs; channel and role identities are never interpreted as independent Cartesian-product sets.

schemaContentHash.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 JSON serialization of the complete state Schema document.

interchangeabilityLevel.description: Controlled interchangeability only. I0 closes exact source and target references for the same part kind under a fixed Profile without requiring one implementation identity, I1 exposes exact data contracts, I2 closes static data and execution semantics, I3 proves a producer-to-consumer chain, and I4 adds migration, acceptance, and rollback evidence. I4 never implies hot reload. F3-F0 values belong only to structuralProvenance.

compatibilityEnvironment.description: An immutable target environment identity used by directed compatibility assessments.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

compatibilityProfile.description: A stable, reusable compatibility context and policy. It does not assert an I-level for any part pair.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

testVector.description: A test definition. It is not evidence that the test has run or passed.

conformanceSuite.description: Versioned test definitions only; execution outcomes belong in conformanceReport.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

conformanceReport.description: An immutable executed-suite report. External EvidenceStatusRecord entries determine whether it is currently admissible; suite definitions alone are never evidence.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.
SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

replacementPlan.description: A controlled replacement linked to one guarded RecipeDiff. replacementMode independently selects restart, rolling, hot-reload, offline, or manual execution; I4 never selects a mode implicitly.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

interchangeabilityAssessment.description: A directed, time-bounded A-to-B interchangeability result under one exact profile and environment. It is evidence, not a reusable rule template.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

assessedLevel.description: The highest interchangeability level derived from this assessment's exact closure and evidence at assessedAt.

levelEvidence.description: Exact executed-report references assigned to evidence-bearing levels. I0 records a closed, identifiable part without claiming exposed contracts; I1 proves exact contract exposure; I2 proves static data alignment. These three levels carry no executed-report evidence. I3 and I4 require reports.

evidenceStatusRecord.description: One immutable entry in an append-only status chain for an exact ConformanceReport. Revocation and tombstone append records and never mutate the report.

recordHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root recordHash member omitted.
